description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusAPI class which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing employment status entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employment statuses, along with validation rules and documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusAPI
classes.description: API controller for CRUD operations on EmploymentStatus entities, supporting endpoints for retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and listing, with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Provides an instance of EmploymentStatusService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single EmploymentStatus by ID, returning its API model representation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne endpoint, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all employment statuses, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing endpoints, including filter and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EmploymentStatus, saving its name from request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new EmploymentStatus, mainly validating 'name'.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing EmploymentStatus identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for the update endpoint, including unique name validation.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring string type, length, and uniqueness.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Helper method to update the EmploymentStatus entity with name from request and save it.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmploymentStatus records by IDs provided in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, primarily the list of IDs.
